data.gender_notes: Basilia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek 'basileus', meaning king or emperor. The name Basilia evokes the image of a regal and noble woman, one who commands respect and inspires awe. The name Basilia carries the meaning “Royal, noble, highborn, basil” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Basilia usually hope their child will grow to embody royal, noble, highborn, basil and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolic of spiritual royalty and purity.
data.etymology: Basilia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Royal, noble, highborn, basil.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Basilia total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: בסילה
in_hebrew.meaning: מלכת המלכים, אשת אורח, נשים קדושות,
in_hebrew.long_meaning: בסילה, שמה של נשים קדושות, היא שמה של נשים שנשאו חיי מידות וחסידות, והיו נשים של תבל. השם בסילה, נזכר בשבעה ספרים. רבים מהשמות הבבליים, והסוריים, שנשאו שמות, מצד האם, והאב, כפי שבעבר. ויש שמות, שנשאו, רק, על שם האם.

in_greek.name: Βασιλία
in_greek.long_meaning: Βασιλία, ονομασία πιστών θηλέων, που δείχνει πίστη, ευσεβία, και θρησκευτικότητα. Ακολουθώντας την παράδοση των πιστών γυναικών του Νέου Testamentου, ονομαζόμενοι Βασιλίσκοι, που σημαίνει βασίλισσες των βασιλέων, οι Βασιλίες, ήταν γυναίκες που ανέπτυξαν εξέχοντες χριστιανικούς διακρίσεις, και έπρεπε να δείξουν τον θρησκευτικό τους πίστη, και την πίστη τους στον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Basilia
in_latin.long_meaning: Basilia, nomen femininum, quod indicat fidem, pietatem, et religiositatem. Secundum traditionem feminarum fidelium Novi Testamenti, qui nuncupabantur Basilicis, quod significat reginae regum, Basiliae erant feminae, quae inchoabant virtutes christianas, et debuerunt ostendere fidem suam, et fidem suam Deo.

in_english.name: Basilia
in_english.meaning: queen of queens, faithful woman, pious woman,
in_english.long_meaning: Basilia, a name of pious women, indicates faith, piety, and religiosity. Following the tradition of faithful women in the New Testament, who were now called Basilia, which means queens of kings, Basilia were women who developed Christian virtues and had to show their faith and devotion to God. The name Basilia is of Hebrew origin, derived from the Greek word for queen, and has been used in Christian tradition to signify a woman of faith and piety.

data.cultural_impact: The name Basilia, with its royal connotations, has been used in various Christian traditions throughout history. In the Byzantine Empire, there were several sainted women named Basilia, including Saint Basilissa of Caesarea (third century) and Saint Basilissa of Thessalonica (fifth century). The name gained widespread popularity during the Middle Ages and was adopted by nobility and royals in Europe. The name continues to be used today, often given as a given name or as a middle name.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, the name Basilia represents the idea of being a queen or ruler in the Kingdom of God. It calls to mind the attributes of a godly woman - strength, wisdom, and grace. The name serves as a reminder to live a life worthy of the kingdom of God, to seek after God's will and to reign over our own lives with the same dignity and respect as a queen. It is a name that inspires us to aspire to greatness in the eyes of God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Basilia, derived from the Greek word for "royal," symbolizes the regal dignity and purity of a Christian, representing the inner king or queen in all believers, and a reminder of their sacred role in God's kingdom.
